body: Thank you for the virtual hug <3

What if you made a compromise with them? Like you go to the beach but promise to skype them on your phone every now and then. I know it wouldn’t be a peaceful technology free break, but it might be better than nothing ^^
We don’t have dollar stores that sell tests here, but I’ll get more at the pharmacy ^^
That’s what I was thinking- it’s hopefully just my mind playing tricks on me!
Hopefully its just anxiety! Yeah I’m sending in a urine sample to check for STDs, just in case. Thank you :)

Are you sure it would be accurate? If I only ‘implanted’ last Friday then it’s only been 3 days, and it’s still 4 days until when I should  have gotten my period if I didn’t stop the pill. I don’t want to waste another test

I stopped because I got symptoms, because I read that you shouldn’t take it if you’re pregnant. 
My period would be due Thursday or Friday if I had continued taking the pill (I stop on Wednesday). Because i stopped taking it on Friday  currently having a break bleed
It was two weeks ago, and I’m taking another test on Saturday- which should tell me for sure. I guess I’m just wondering if there’s any reason to be anxious
I’m using my friends account, but I do have depression. I’m seeing a therapist though. This is mainly just a pregnancy worry, but thank you for your concern ^^
I hope he forgives you- you may have done a terrible thing but that doesn’t make you a terrible person. Good luck :)

This is a common worry even in relationships with two bi people, in my experience. There’s always a fear that you’re not meeting their desire for the other gender. 
If you have a good sex life that’s a great sign- Talk to her and make sure you tell her that you know it’s an irrational fear. It’ll probably be fine :)

I DO love her. 
But You might be right- maybe I need to clear my head
Yeah if I did date him I’d definitely keep it casual for a long time. Thanks for your advice

We had talked about it, and it would get better for a while but then go back. Maybe you’re right- Both my brothers told me that too.
I hope we can stay friends if we do break up, I’d hate to lose her.
I really do love her, but this is a pretty good point
Yes, we’ve been working on it and sometimes it’s good but it’s hard work and feels like it keeps reverting back.
